title: Satricum
description: This unlocated place, named Satricum, is included on map 44 of the Barrington Atlas. N. Purcell cites Nissen, which leads to a citation from a letter written by M. Tullius Cicero to his brother, Quintus Tullius Cicero. The former is travelling by road and has been at Laterium, where he observed a small bridge and a temple sacred to Furina. In his discussion of distance and road conditions, he mentions the toponym Satricum as being further along the road than the shrine.
